title: ObjectFlow flow description (draft 2)
description: The structure of a flow description, the one written form of an ObjectFlow flow (ADR-0116). Normative for structure only: the rules this schema cannot express, and the meaning of every key, are in docs/design/flow-format.md, and scripts/check-flows.py checks them all.

imports.description: Types used from other modules, by module name.

categories.description: The state categories the module's states use, such as live and closed.

enumerations.description: Named sets of values. A value is written qualified, as Condition.DAMAGED.

sequences.description: Named counters that mint identifiers (declaration-syntax.md §1, §3.1), by name.

evaluators.description: Systems outside the store a guard may ask, by name (declaration-syntax.md §6.2).

machines.description: State machines several types share, by name (UML StateMachine).

metrics.description: Metrics that combine other metrics, across the module's types (declaration-syntax.md §6.9, ADR-0118).

migration.description: How a publish of this version moves the live objects of the version before it (declaration-syntax.md §6.6).

expression.description: An expression of the model's expression language (declaration-syntax.md §8); a boolean or a number may be written as YAML's own, and stands for that literal.

description.description: What an object of the type is, in one or more sentences.

abstract.description: true for a base that has no objects of its own; the types that extend it inherit its attributes, derived attributes and invariants.

extends.description: The abstract base this type inherits attributes, derived attributes and invariants from, and its tracking; never its transitions.

mirror.description: true for a type another system owns: this store holds it, only the import writes it, and it takes no transition but an erasure (ADR-0075, ADR-0101).

state_machine.description: The shared state machine this type binds, declared in the module or imported (UML classifierBehavior); a binder declares no states of its own.

transitions.description: The type's transitions, by name; a transition's name is its trigger.

conditions.description: Named conditions, used as guards by the transitions.

derived_attributes.description: Attributes whose value is an expression over the object, never written (UML Property::isDerived); each reads only those declared above it.

summary.description: The members a listing returns by default, state included (DESIGN.md §5.2).

invariants.description: Conditions that hold for every object of the type at all times.

observations.description: Datapoints recorded about an object and never changed afterwards, by name.

metrics.description: Figures computed from the record of many objects.

description.description: What it means for an object to be in the state.

final.description: No transition leaves this state (UML FinalState).

required_attributes.description: Attributes that have a value whenever an object is in this state.

superseding.description: The object ends here by being superseded: a transition into it names the successor with a supersede step. It is final.

kind.description: UML: initial transition, external transition, internal transition. And two with no UML counterpart: assertion, which puts an object into a state the request names, from any state, as an override; erasure, which erases the object's personal attributes at any state.

from.description: The source state, or states, or any: every state that is not final. Required for external and internal transitions; absent for an initial one, an assertion and an erasure.

to.description: The target state: one for an initial or external transition; for an assertion, the states it may put an object in. Absent for an internal transition and an erasure.

description.description: What the transition does, in one sentence.

only_via.description: The transitions, as Type.transition, that alone may take this one, by a call, a create or a cascade; no caller may request it.

proposable.description: true if a request for this transition may be filed as a proposal, executed as its approver when approved (ADR-0036).

corrects.description: The attributes this transition corrects: it writes exactly these, and its events carry the corrected provenance.

may_admit.description: On an assertion: the invariants a request may admit breaking, this type's or <Type>.<invariant> of a type reachable by a relationship.

required_inputs.description: Attributes the caller must supply; each is written to the attribute of the same name.

optional_inputs.description: Attributes the caller may supply; each is written if supplied.

inputs.description: Declared inputs that write no attribute of their own name, by name; read in expressions as inputs.<name>.

guards.description: Conditions evaluated, in this order, after the required inputs are checked.

effect.description: The writes the transition makes, in this order (UML Transition::effect).

backdating_limit.description: How far in the past a caller may say the change happened.

assign.description: Writes the value of expr to the attribute named by location (SCXML <assign>).

clear.description: Removes the values of the listed optional attributes.

add.description: Adds the value of expr to the set-valued attribute named by location.

remove.description: Removes the value of expr from the set-valued attribute named by location.

inputs.description: The inputs passed to the transition, each an expression.

call.description: Takes a transition of another object, which evaluates its guards and records its own event (UML CallOperationAction).

inputs.description: The inputs passed to the transition, each an expression.

create.description: Creates an object by an initial transition of its type; result names it for later steps (UML CreateObjectAction).

foreach.description: Runs steps for each element of array that satisfies where, or for each number from 1 to range, over a snapshot taken when the loop starts; a request that would run more than limit times is refused with over-limit, never truncated (SCXML <foreach>; ADR-0122).

supersede.description: The successor that supersedes this object: an input, or a name an earlier create step binds.

description.description: The condition, stated as what holds when it is satisfied.

expression.description: The condition in the expression language (declaration-syntax.md §8).

remedy.description: What a caller can do when the condition fails (DESIGN.md §5.5).

evaluation.description: For a condition that calls an evaluator: eager, consulted whenever availability is computed, the default; or deferred, only when the transition is requested.

description.description: The invariant, stated as what always holds.

expression.description: The invariant in the expression language.
The value, in the expression language (declaration-syntax.md §8); its type is the expression's.

indexed.description: Queries may filter on it; it then reads only this object's indexed attributes, single references and state, and no clock (declaration-syntax.md §7, check 46).

identifier.description: The value is minted from a sequence when the object is created.

sequence.description: The sequence the number is taken from, declared in the module or imported.

scope.description: A reference, or an indexed attribute, that every creation writes; the sequence numbers each of its values separately.

format.description: The text minted: {n} or {n:<width>} for the number, {<attribute>} or {<reference>.<attribute>} for a string or enumeration value, and [ … ] around a segment left out when a value inside it is absent.

type.description: A built-in type (string, bool, int, decimal(p,s), money(ccy), timestamp, duration, identity, file) or an enumeration's name; or counter, an int never absent and zero at creation, on a type tracked by quantity.

reference.description: The type of object this attribute names, declared in the module or imported; [] makes it a set.

opposite.description: The attribute of the referenced type that is the other end of this relationship (UML Property::opposite).

stored.description: On one of two single ends: this end holds the value, and the other is read from it.

aggregation.description: composite: the referenced objects are parts of this one, exclusively and for no longer than it (UML AggregationKind::composite).

cascade.description: On a composite end: the transition each part takes when this object takes one of the listed transitions.

survives.description: On a composite end: true if the parts outlive every final transition of this object, or the transitions they outlive.

description.description: What the attribute holds, where the name alone does not say.

optional.description: true if the attribute may be without a value.

default.description: The value every creation that does not write the attribute gives it: a literal, a qualified value or now.

external.description: The system that owns this value, such as legacy or xero; its values are unique per source and may be absent.

unique.description: No two objects hold the same value: true across the type; in_scope, per the identifier's scope; with, together with the attributes listed; where, among the objects the expression holds for.

actor_kind.description: On an identity attribute: the kind of actor objects of this type are.

assignee.description: On a reference: it names who is responsible for the object.

unit.description: On an observation's attribute: the unit of the measured value.

max_recording_delay.description: How long after the fact a datapoint may still be recorded.

measure.description: median_time_in_state of a state, or transition_count of a transition.

group_by.description: month, week, actor, or an attribute of the type.

flag_when.description: Named flags, each an expression over value and the dimensions.

measureMetric.description: A fixed measure: the median time in a state, or the number of times a transition is taken.

formulaMetric.description: A metric written in the model's metric language (declaration-syntax.md §6.9): an expression aggregated over the rows of a source, grouped by dimensions.

source.description: The rows: objects, intervals, intervals(<member>), transitions, attempts, attempt_counts, labels, or an observation kind of the type.

anyOf.description: An observation kind of the type.

item.description: The name each row is read by.

filter.description: The rows counted: those the expression holds for (dbt's filter, a WHERE clause).

dimensions.description: The groups: a mapping from a dimension's name to an expression over the row.

time_dimension.description: The timestamp a window over last <duration> selects rows by.

expression.description: The value, aggregated over the rows of one group.

flag_when.description: Named flags, each an expression over value and the dimensions.

input.description: A value the caller supplies with a request, recorded with the event and written only where an effect writes it.

type.description: A built-in type or an enumeration's name; [] makes the input a set.

reference.description: The type of object the input names; [] makes it a set of objects.

optional.description: true if the caller may leave the input out.

personal.description: true if erasure redacts the input from every event that recorded it.

default.description: The value used when the caller leaves the input out; not allowed on an optional input.

on.description: The transitions of this object that drive the cascade.

inputs.description: The inputs passed to each part's transition, each an expression over this object and the triggering transition's inputs.

limit.description: The most parts the cascade may reach in one request.

requires.description: What a type that binds this machine must declare.

attributes.description: The attributes the machine's conditions and effects read or write, as a binder must declare them.

invariants.description: The invariants a binder must declare.

conditions.description: Named conditions, used as guards by the transitions.

transitions.description: The type's transitions, by name; a transition's name is its trigger.

description.description: What this version changes, and how its live objects are moved.

removed_states.description: For each type, each state the previous version had and this one does not, and the state its objects move to.

removed_members.description: For each enumeration, each member the previous version had and this one does not, and the member live values become.

renamed_attributes.description: For each type, each attribute renamed, from its old name to its new one.

backfill.description: For each type, each attribute a live object must be given, and the expression over the object's own members and literals that gives it.

invariant.description: <Type>.<invariant>, which objects may still break after the publish.

admit.description: Invariants the migrated objects may break, each admitted with a reason, as an assertion's admissions are.

description.description: The system asked, and what it owns.

arguments.description: Its arguments, in the order a call passes them.

fresh.description: How old a verdict may be and still be used, such as 30 min.

combinedMetric.description: A metric whose value combines other metrics' values, joined by their dimensions (dbt's derived metric).

input_metrics.description: A mapping from the name the expression reads to a metric: <Type>.<metric>, or a combined metric declared above.

group_by.description: The dimensions to group by, each a dimension of an input metric.

expression.description: The value, combining the input metrics' values by their names.

flag_when.description: Named flags, each an expression over value and the dimensions.
